s6-hidden-sfi-clusters.base: SFI_ComputeClusters in fsw/src/sfi_cluster.c (declared in fsw/src/sfi_cluster.h with the pinned signature and SFI_ClusterResult_t) must, for onsets in any order, sort them by full time (subseconds included) and report ClusterCount, LargestClusterSize and Correlation, where a cluster is a maximal run in which each consecutive pair is at most WindowSec apart. SFI_ComputeClusters must not modify the caller's Onsets array: it is const, and casting the qualifier away is not allowed. It sorts a local copy of at most SFI_HISTORY_LEN entries, with no dynamic allocation.

cases.No recent misses: with no onsets the result is ClusterCount 0, LargestClusterSize 0 and Correlation NONE (0)
cases.A single miss: a single onset is one cluster of size 1 with Correlation UNCORRELATED (1)
cases.Equal onset times: equal onset times are 0 apart and form one cluster, Correlation CLUSTERED (2)
cases.Gap of exactly W: onsets exactly W seconds apart (full time, subseconds included) belong to the same cluster
cases.Gap just above W: onsets more than W seconds apart, even by one subsecond, are in different clusters
cases.Window of one second: a window of 1 second applies the same rule at subsecond precision
cases.Unsorted onsets: onsets given in any order are evaluated sorted by onset
cases.Chained onsets: a cluster is a chain: consecutive gaps of at most W join onsets even when the first and last are further apart
cases.Largest cluster: LargestClusterSize is the size of the largest cluster wherever it lies
cases.Sixteen onsets: a full history of 16 onsets is evaluated
cases.Large onset times: onset seconds anywhere in the 32-bit range are compared without overflow or wrap-around
cases.Onsets in read-only storage: onsets the caller passes in read-only storage are evaluated without being written to (the const array is never modified, sorted in place or cast to a writable pointer)
